[Unit]
Description=The PHP 8.3 FastCGI Process Manager
Documentation=man:php-fpm8.3(8)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=notify
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/php-fpm8.3 --nodaemonize --fpm-config /etc/php/8.3/fpm/php-fpm.conf
ExecStartPost=-/usr/lib/php/php-fpm-socket-helper install /run/php/php-fpm.sock /etc/php/8.3/fpm/pool.d/www.conf 83
ExecStopPost=-/usr/lib/php/php-fpm-socket-helper remove /run/php/php-fpm.sock /etc/php/8.3/fpm/pool.d/www.conf 83
ExecReload=/bin/kill -USR2 $MAINPID

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

actions: Create private read-only configuration snapshots and authenticated temporary service definitions
Reload systemd definitions and restart the declared services
Warm and verify the explicitly declared loopback probes; record kernel/process/configuration evidence
interruption: Requests on every declared service may be interrupted; preparation does not install packages.
